title: Show HN: Kapso – Iterative learning from enterprise data
summary: Hey HN! We're Alireza and Majid building Leeroo ( https://leeroo.com/ ). Previously we’ve built AI systems for products with millions of users, including at LinkedIn and Meta. We’re now focusing on building AI systems for enterprise data. Today, we're open-sourcing Kapso ( https://github.com/Leeroo-AI/kapso ), an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution, and learns from every run. The nature of data work is iterative: investigate, form hypotheses, experiment, and improve based on what you learn. This bottom-up process is the only way to deliver meaningful outcomes quickly in large, messy enterprise data environments. Consultants gathering context in meetings or teams defining a business ontology upfront to fit into the data has no chance of execution, in quarters and sometimes years. An AI-native system should automate this process, compounding learning to each new investigation and implementation. For instance, one of our enterprise projects was moving a company off it

title: Show HN: AgentRun – open-source, Self-improving Managed Agents
summary:
We (GREP.AI, YC F26) are open-sourcing AgentRun and turning it into a full managed agents platform. Read more about it in this post:  https://agentrun.ai/blog/introducing-agentrun-run-smarter-ag... . It includes what we originally built for our own agent harness: - Self-improving agents 
- Web-grounded workflows 
- A range of sandboxes and computer environments 
- Thousands of tools and integrations 
- Detailed analytics on how your agents behave You can bring your own agent. AgentRun works with Pi, Claude Agents, Codex, OpenCode, and any other harness that supports ACP. You can self-host it (see 1-click install on Render) with an OpenRouter key, or try the hosted version at console.agentrun.ai. We’d love feedback, especially on the architecture (see README), or anything we may be missing to make it useful to you.
